records.text: ports/CMakeLists.txt requires a 32-bit target (CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P == 4) and links Windows targets (mvc2.exe, mvc2dc.exe) with -Wl,--disable-dynamicbase so 0x0C000000 stays free for naomi_map_ram(). Build on Windows under MSYS2 MINGW32 (i686-w64-mingw32) with SDL3 i686 CMake prefix: cmake -G Ninja -B build -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=gcc -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=<sdl3>/i686-w64-mingw32, ninja -C build, cmake --install build --prefix build-dist (build/ and build-*/ are ignored by ports/.gitignore).

ports/port/sdl/start.c locates game data relative to SDL_GetBasePath(): roms/mvsc2 for arcade (or arcade= in mvc2.cfg / MVC2_ROM) and disc for Dreamcast (or dc= in mvc2.cfg / MVC2_DC_DISC / CLI arg). Setting unlock = all in mvc2.cfg unlocks all characters, colors, and stages without altering saves (vmu_save_A1.bin, eeprom.bin, backup.bin).

Dreamcast mode validates USA disc files via dc_disc_check() in ports/port/dc/dc_gd.c: 1ST_READ.BIN (1809817), AICADRV.BIN (59264), FONT.BIN (73792), SELTEX.BIN (1591990), PL00_DAT.BIN (557408), PL3A_DAT.BIN (464448), STG00POL.BIN (173976), ADX_SELC.BIN (417792).

Setting MVC2_FRAMES=<N> switches ports/port/sdl/main_sdl.c into deterministic test_run mode (no gamepad init, skips missing_screen dialog on missing data, no audio device opened, defaults renderer to soft rules unless configured gpu, supports MVC2_PRESS=frame:key,... and exits after N frames).
